newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn called steady to 1/2 cent lower.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn called steady to 1/2 cent lower.

text.p: CBOT corn futures were called to open steady to 1/2 cent per bushel lower on lighter-than-expected corn exports in USDA's weekly export sales report, traders said.
USDA Friday said U.S. net export sales for corn were at 797,300 tonnes for the week ended November 7, below trade expectations for 900,000 to 1.1 million tonnes.
Futures will be underpinned by slow farmer selling and a slowdown in corn harvesting due to harsh weather in the U.S. Midwest.
